Do you run analytics on API usage?

For Explanation:
* If yes, please briefly (1) describe your process and (2) how you use the insights to improve the portal

Besides monitoring portal traffic, do you perform any further activities to better understand the behaviour and needs of users of your portal (e.g. web analytics, surveys, or analysis of social media feeds)?

For Explanation:
* If yes, please (1) specify the activities and explain (2) how they help you understand user needs
column4: We did a survey last year: https://www.bfs.admin.ch/bfs/en/home/services/ogd/documentation.assetdetail.23445843.html and we regularly check twitter statistics
column7: We did a survey in 2022: https://www.bfs.admin.ch/bfs/en/home/services/ogd/documentation.assetdetail.23445843.html. This helped us to better understand the needs and expectations of users and providers of open government data in Switzerland. The results were incorporated into the development of the OGD masterplan 2024-2027. The masterplan was developed last year in a participatory manner (workshop), incorporating the needs of users. We regularly check twitter statistics and LinkedIn statistics.

column2:
Do you used the insights about portal usage and about the behaviour and needs of portal users to improve the portal accordingly?

For Explanation:
* If yes, please explain your process for improving the portal based on user insights and feedback
* If relevant, kindly highlight some improvements made in the past year
column7:
One of the most common user feedback was that open and machine-readable formats should be used. Since then, we have been trying to raise awareness among data publishers. In addition, we are now trying to provide aids and tools to support data quality. 
The results of the above-mentioned survey (PT25)are also being incorporated into our opendata.swiss next project.

column2:
Do you undertake any activities to promote the portal and attract new users or new audiences?

For explanation:
* If yes, please (1) explain what activities your perform, and (2) mention if these activities are directed at any specific target audience (e.g. business, public sector, academia, etc.)
column7: We participate in many events. For example in the Govtech Hackathon 2023 and 2024. With a challenge, we can present the portal to a wider audience (academia, business, public sector). In addition, different people can contribute to the improvement of our portal and get to know it from a different perspective. We also make presentations and contributions to various areas of the public sector and academia. We also promote it a lot on social media (LinkedIn, Instagram, X) and through our newsletter.

column2:
Do you monitor what keywords are used to search for data and content on the portal?

For Explanation:
* If yes, please briefly (1) describe your process and (2) how you use the insights to improve the portal
column7: We monitoring keywords with matomo. The results give us a better understanding of how and what people search on opendata.swiss. These insights into search terms help us, among other factors, to improve the search function on opendata.swiss so that datasets can be found more easily. They also provide information on which topics are relevant for the user in a given time frame.

column2:
Do you monitor the most and least consulted pages?

For Explanation:
* If yes, please briefly (1) describe your process and (2) how you use the insights to improve the portal
* For informational purposes, kindly provide the URLs to the five most popular datasets on the portal
column7:
Yes, we use Matomo. There we have custom properties (e.g. dataset, organization) and you can see which pages are the most/least visited in a time frame. But you can also see which organization is the most/least visited and within an organization which page is the most/least visited. Publishers may need this information to improve their offerings (e.g. dataset and which distribution is high in demand) or to promote datasets that are not in high demand.

2.3 Data provision

To what degree do public sector data providers contribute data to the portal? 

For Explanation:
*Please describe what is the agreed approach.
* If less than the majority of data providers, please briefly explain why (e.g. technical incompatibilities, governance aspects, low awareness etc.).
column3: approximately half of the public sector data providers
column4: Today, participation is encouraged by the different OGD strategies. A law regulating the provision of OGD at federal level will come into force on 1 January 2024. Within the next 4 years, we aim to have all providers at the federal level. For the cantonal and communal level, the law is only valid for guidance; here we are aiming for the majority.
